findings.title: `firstName` returns the second word instead of the first
findings.body:
The function `firstName` uses `split(" ")[1]` which returns the second word. For "Ada Lovelace", it returns "Lovelace" instead of "Ada". This causes `welcomeBack("Ada Lovelace")` to return "Welcome back, Lovelace!" instead of "Welcome back, Ada!".

**Evidence:**
- Input: `"Ada Lovelace"`
- Expected: `"Ada"` (first word)
- Actual: `"Lovelace"` (second word, index 1)

**Fix:** Change `split(" ")[1]` to `split(" ")[0]`.
